title: Overseas in Sicily and Italy, avoiding K.P.
summary: He spent twelve months overseas, did little work, avoided peeling potatoes, and showed a couple of movies a week.

story.theme_name: Drafted: musicians in the military and the war years
story.community_name: Drafted: service bands, USO shows and the war years

blocks.x: Where were you stationed overseas first? I mean, where did you go first?
I went to Sicily.
And what did you do there?
Nothing. Nothing. There wasn't nothing to do now. I slept all day.
Oh, and what were you supposed to be doing?
I wasn't supposed to be working. I wasn't working.
Well, what were you supposed to be doing? What kind of work?
First place, they had me on, what do you call it? Peer them potatoes. I wasn't going to peel no potatoes.
That's K.P.?
K.P.
They sent you to diesel school so you could peel potatoes?
I didn't peel no potatoes.
What did you do?
I ate them potatoes.
With the skins on?
Sometimes I had baked potatoes, baked potatoes, you know, just baked them.
Potatoes treat under my day.
It was hard to know. They had to take your spoon in the way. It was hard to know.
And then where did you go after Sicily?
I went to Italy.
And what did you do there? Nothing again? What were you supposed to be doing?
I was supposed to have been working. When they looked for me, I went over here a couple times.
Well, I mean, what was your job in the Army, actually?
My job was supposed to have been a special service.
But for doing what?
Showing the movies.
Oh, that's all you were supposed to, that's all you did? Just show movies? Show movies,
that's all. I showed maybe one or two movies a week. And then my job was over.
And the rest of the time you just left?
That's right.
And how long did you stay overseas?
Twelve months.
And where else did you go besides Sicily and here and where else?
That's all.
That's all? And then you came back here?
Came back to the state. Came back to Hattiesburg and got this charge.
And then you came home?
Came home.
